title: Health provider point source acquisition queue

provenance.locator: service-eligible provider-point rows still blocked for no-point-evidence, prioritised by remaining Ministry candidate signal, ownership and bed counts
provenance.note: This queue is source-acquisition work planning. It does not promote candidate rows into point evidence.

sourceTypes.label: Provider official website or contact page
County DSP, county council or local authority provider page
CNAS or other official contracting/register source
OSM named hospital feature checked manually against provider identity
Existing Ministry locality-only candidate checked against a provider-specific source

acceptanceRules.text: A new acceptance must name the provider or its official operator and carry locality/county context; locality-name overlap alone is not enough.
A source-record alias can fill address evidence only when the accepted source row or external provider-specific source contains street-address evidence.
Published coordinates may be accepted without address evidence only through a reviewed coordinate-only method that preserves addressEvidence.method none.
Every adopted external source must record URL, publisher, retrieval date, checksum where applicable and license/usage limitation.

limitations.text: This queue names work to find evidence. It must not be consumed as provider coordinates, address aliases or routing input.
Remaining Ministry candidates are low-signal locality overlaps. They require provider-specific corroboration before any alias or coordinate acceptance can be created.
Any future adopted provider website, authority page, register or OSM-derived record must carry URL, publisher, retrieval date and license or usage limitation in the accepting source file.
